blocks.text: The most common biological hazards are allergens, infectious diseases that are transferred from animals to humans, and viral diseases (Figure 16.3 as printed).

blocks.caption: Biological hazards
rows: infectious diseases transferred from animals to humans

blocks.prompt: Why does the text list 'infectious diseases transferred from animals to humans' as a laboratory hazard?
blocks.explanation: Biological material and animals handled in a laboratory can carry infections that pass to people, so they are a biological hazard alongside allergens and viral diseases.

items: Biological hazards: allergens, infectious diseases from animals to humans, viral diseases.
